description: Weaken the overdraw comparison so requests up to double stock are allowed
expected_violation: A request exceeding available stock is reserved instead of rejected
violation_scenario: reserve_stock(StockItem(sku='SKU-01', available=10), 11) drives available to -1 instead of raising.
rationale: Comparing against double the available quantity lets a modest overdraw through while the existing at-or-below-stock tests still pass.
